requirements.name: Input echo and AAM routing
requirements.clause: The reader starts at t=0, echoes every request, and AAM routes valid requests onward while invalid requests logout after its processing delay.

requirements.name: Account-number verification
requirements.clause: Every valid AAM output receives one mutually exclusive ANV pass/fail result after 10 seconds.

requirements.name: Password retry-until-success
requirements.clause: Every ANV pass reaches PV, which reports eventual success and a positive attempt count after its processing delay.

requirements.name: Bounded bill generation
requirements.clause: Every password success produces an integer bill amount in [0,40] after 10 seconds.

requirements.name: Transaction state continuity
requirements.clause: TPM subtracts each bill from an initial balance of 3000, prevents overdraft, and increments the transaction count after 10 seconds.

requirements.name: End-to-end flow conservation
requirements.clause: Every request follows exactly one valid or invalid branch, and every passed downstream stage has a corresponding successor through TPM.

requirements.name: ANV Bernoulli behavior
requirements.clause: Across repeated cases ANV passes with probability 0.5.

requirements.name: PV attempt probability
requirements.clause: Across repeated cases each PV password attempt succeeds with probability 0.5 while retrying until success.
